title: Shallow Corn Planting Depth Decreases Yield Uniformity
reason: The video describes the impact of varying corn planting depths on crop yield and emergence uniformity.

tasks.task: Explain the benefits of deeper corn planting for yield improvement.

subtasks.text: Describe planting corn deeper can sometimes lead to higher yields due to more uniform emergence.
